info.title: API.SH: Thomasnet
info.description: The Thomasnet API from API.SH: public Thomasnet data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Thomasnet's product and service category directory: the top-level categories, a category's subcategories, or a leaf category's supplier headings (each with its supplier count and its supplier listing link), plus the category's description, buying-guide articles and white papers. Leave category out for the top level; 150 entries a page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thomasnet-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path (adhesives-sealants or adhesives-sealants/adhesives, as in each subcategory's category field) or a thomasnet.com/browse/... link. Leave it out for the top-level categories.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of subcategories or headings (150 a page).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Industrial suppliers on Thomasnet for a product or service: id, name, profile link, description, supplier type (manufacturer, distributor, service company...), tier, phone, website, logo, employees, annual sales, year founded, address with coordinates, capabilities (materials, industries, production scale), categories, products and videos; plus the matched category, related categories, the total number of suppliers and the site's filter options with counts. Returns the first 25 suppliers (the site shows later pages to signed-in users only); narrow with `region`. Narrow with the site's own filters: supplier validation, video type, catalogs, production scale and brand (values from `filters` of an unfiltered search); several values of one filter must all match. `applied_filters` echoes them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thomasnet-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Product or service, e.g. `cnc machining`, `valves`, `injection molding`.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region name as Thomasnet writes it, e.g. `northern-ohio`, `southern-california`, `texas-southern`, `new-york-city`; needs a `q` that matches a supplier category.

parameters.name: supplier_validation
parameters.description: `thomas_verified`, `thomas_registered` or `xometry_verified`; comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: video_type
parameters.description: Suppliers with a video of this type: `factory_tour`, `company_overview`, `product_spotlight` or `project_spotlight`.

parameters.name: catalogs
parameters.description: Suppliers with catalogs: `any`, `product_catalogs`, `capabilities_profile` or `line_card`.

parameters.name: production_scale
parameters.description: Production scale, comma-separated: High Volume, Long Run, Low Volume, Production Runs, Prototype, Short Run, Small Batch, Toll.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: A brand from the `Brands` filter, e.g. `Haas`.

parameters.name: company_type
parameters.description: Supplier types from the `Company Type` filter, comma-separated: M (manufacturer), D (distributor), C (custom manufacturer), S (service company), F (finishing service), I (systems integrator), R (manufacturers' rep), E (remanufacturer).

parameters.name: certifications
parameters.description: Ids from the `Quality Certifications`, `Compliance & Registrations` or `Ownership / Diversity` filters, comma-separated (e.g. 146 for AISC).

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Ids from the `Industries` filter, comma-separated, e.g. `Aerospace`.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Ids from the `Materials` filter, comma-separated, e.g. `Stainless Steel`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Thomasnet's search box suggestions for a partial term: popular searches with their result counts, matching supplier categories (heading id, slug, supplier count, listing link) and matching suppliers (id, logo, address, profile link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thomasnet-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The partial search term.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Suggestions of each kind (1-20, default 5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A supplier's Thomasnet profile: name, description, type, tier, phone, website, logo, employees, annual sales, year founded, address, capabilities, categories, products and catalogs, videos, news headlines, business details sections and locations.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/thomasnet-supplier

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Supplier profile link.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Thomasnet supplier id (the number at the end of the profile link), e.g. `400300`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
